review.imagery: 40 gallery entries include 13 dated site photographs. All 22 primary assets, the full 34-page brochure index, eight native resources and thirteen September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. One exact primary repeat and two repeated bedroom angles were excluded. Six brochure scenes add distinct pool, clubhouse, gym and garden views. Home living and kitchen scenes supply the interior section. The complete dusk building supplies card and hero.
review.floorPlans: All three whole original physical pages 2–4 were visually reviewed. Three freely displayed broker studio drawings were independently viewed at native size. Their small drawing-position numbers do not identify contractual homes. No numerical area is printed. Remaining broker layouts are form-gated and unretrieved. Complete original margins, level grouping, technical notes and source links are preserved. Three whole-building drawings and three attributed broker studio previews are available. No numerical saleable area is printed. Image positions do not establish contractual unit numbers. Confirm final individual areas and revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: Complete original brochure map 6 was rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. Its concentric time bands do not supply individual route estimates. The current official named-place embed has no explicit target coordinates. Camera-centre values were excluded.
review.provenance: Official HTML/gallery and September 2026 history pages retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Branded brochure and complete building drawings retain Mitchell’s broker-mirror attribution. Public unit previews, where available, retain their separately observed broker image URLs. Full source bytes and notices remain intact. Original text research and protected identities are preserved.

unavailable: Individual contractual saleable areas, contractual unit matching, remaining form-gated broker plans, exact visitor entrance, individually sourced travel estimates, current certified site progress and final specifications remain unavailable or unverified.
